name: spm featured
description: A curated index of agent-skill repositories, importable with `spm catalog import`.

repos.name: anthropic
repos.description: Anthropic's official Agent Skills: document tools (pdf, docx, pptx, xlsx), MCP builder, web app testing, frontend and canvas design, and more.

repos.name: openai
repos.description: OpenAI's curated Codex skills: Playwright, Figma, security reviews, deploys (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare, Render), ASP.NET Core, WinUI, and more.

repos.name: uno-platform
repos.description: Uno Platform skills for building cross-platform C#/XAML apps: MVUX, navigation, toolkit controls, and theming.

repos.name: msaf
repos.description: Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF/MSAF) architecture and API guidance: the msaf-architect skill.

repos.name: vercel
repos.description: Vercel's official skills: deploy to Vercel, the Vercel CLI with tokens, performance optimization, React best practices, React Native, view transitions, and web design/writing guidelines.

repos.name: cloudflare
repos.description: Cloudflare's official skills for the developer platform: Workers, Pages, storage (KV/D1/R2), Agents SDK, Durable Objects, Sandbox SDK, Turnstile, Cloudflare One, and Terraform/Pulumi IaC.

repos.name: huggingface
repos.description: Hugging Face's official skills for the ML ecosystem: the hf CLI, model and dataset workflows, inference serving, and cloud/SageMaker deployment.

repos.name: stripe
repos.description: Stripe's official skills: integration best practices, docs lookup, project setup, Connect recommendations, and Stripe SDK upgrades.

repos.name: google-jules
repos.description: Google Labs skills for the Jules coding agent: automate GitHub issues and verify local actions.
